# Support BandPilot

[Français](SUPPORT_FR.md) · [English](SUPPORT_EN.md) · [Italiano](SUPPORT_IT.md) · [Español](SUPPORT_ES.md) · [Deutsch](SUPPORT_DE.md)

More time playing, less time searching for a setting. BandPilot helps bands prepare their sound checks and keep familiar setups with a free, open tool.

## What your support helps with

- Time to reproduce problems, fix bugs and maintain Windows, macOS, Linux and Android installers.
- Documented tests across mixer models, instruments and listening setups: front of house, stage monitors, in-ears, headphones and mixed configurations.
- Clearer guides, translations and workflows that musicians can understand at every experience level.

Support is voluntary and optional. BandPilot remains freely available under the MIT license. Support does not unlock paid features or guarantee a fix date, a newly supported mixer or a particular sound. Priorities follow observed needs and testing.

## Financial support

[Support on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/bandpilot)

The Ko-fi link, when available, opens an external service. BandPilot does not process payments and this site loads no Ko-fi widget. The payment service’s terms apply on its page.

## Other ways to help

Report a reproducible problem with the version, mixer model and your use case. Share hardware tests and distinguish simulation from a real mixer. Suggest a translation, improve a guide or introduce BandPilot to another band. Review screenshots and logs before posting: remove names, contact details and private information.
